Solve this Python programming problem.

Write a function to convert rgb color to hsv color. https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/program-change-rgb-color-model-hsv-color-model/

Your code must pass tests like this one:
assert rgb_to_hsv(255, 255, 255)==(0, 0.0, 100.0)

Reply with the complete solution in a single ```python code block. Include any imports it needs. Don't include the tests.

```python
def rgb_to_hsv(r, g, b):
    # Normalize RGB values to the range [0, 1]
    r, g, b = r / 255.0, g / 255.0, b / 255.0
    
    # Find the maximum and minimum values of RGB
    max_val = max(r, g, b)
    min_val = min(r, g, b)
    
    # Calculate the difference between max and min
    diff = max_val - min_val
    
    # Calculate the Hue
    if max_val == min_val:
        h = 0
    elif max_val == r:
        h = (60 * ((g - b) / diff) + 360) % 360
    elif max_val == g:
        h = (60 * ((b - r) / diff) + 120) % 360
    elif max_val == b:
        h = (60 * ((r - g) / diff) + 240) % 360
    
    # Calculate the Saturation
    if max_val == 0:
        s = 0
    else:
        s = (diff / max_val) * 100
    
    # Calculate the Value
    v = max_val * 100
    
    return (h, s, v)
```
